did.abstract: Betty Jetter was active in lesbian separatist communities and conversations, particularly with the Califia Community, which organized feminist educational retreats. She was also a poet and participant in local lesbian politics. This collection contains personal correspondence and material about Califia community organizing and feminist organization Sol Sisters, as well as ephemera, photographs, and collected readings.

odd.head: Sponsor
odd.p: The June L. Mazer Lesbian Archive at UCLA is an outreach and collection-building partnership between the June L. Mazer Lesbian Archives, the UCLA Center for the Study of Women (CSW), and the UCLA Library. These collections expand the pool of primary source materials available to researchers and to the community at large. This partnership was initiated by CSW and is funded by the National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH) to inventory, organize, preserve, and digitize more than eighty Mazer collections pertaining to lesbian and feminist activism and writings.

bioghist.head: Biography/History
bioghist.p: Betty Jetter was active in lesbian separatist communities and conversations, particularly with the Califia community. She was also a poet and participant in local lesbian politics.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: The bulk of the collection is made up of both audio and paper correspondence between Betty Jetter and her former lover, Joy Howard. The correspondence deals with both women's experiences within the lesbian community as well as their opinions and thoughts on contemporary political issues such as sadomasochism, lesbian separatism, and pornography. In addition, there is a substantial amount of material about Califia Community retreats for women and the feminist group Sol Sisters, as well as readings, poems, photographs, and ephemera created or collected by Betty Jetter.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Letters from Joy Howard to Betty Jetter discussing their relationship, lesbian oppression, patriarchy, academics, feminist activism, motherhood, personal matters and other topics.

odd.head: General note
odd.p: Correspondence may be carefully removed from sheet protectors for consultation.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Registration forms and letters, directions to the campsite, rules and regulations as well as other pertinent information for the duration of Califia Community, a feminist educational retreat which Betty Jetter participated in.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Registration information for attendees of Califia with special needs or low income.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Packet covering rules, regulations, activities and goals of the Califia Community.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Mock-ups of the newsletter published by Sol Sisters, a group "organized for Social and Political purposes in order to create a safe environment for women working towards a feminist reality."

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Various published materials concerning lesbian culture and political issues including discussions of lesbian separatism and sadomasochism, some of which were written by Jetter.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Assorted materials including stickers, programs for events, and cartoons.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Photographs of Califia retreats, personal cruises and other social events.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Handwritten excerpts of Betty Jetter's journal.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Includes published novels, zines and buttons collected by Betty Jetter. Also includes three audio cassettes of readings and performances as well as one documentary on VHS.
